uses: Use Prevention and alleviation of these symptoms associated with motion sickness: ·Nausea ·Dizziness ·Vomiting
otcwarn: Do not use Pregnant women, breastfeeding mothers, children under the age of 4 should not use. Do not use if the skin has abnormalities, wounds, eczema, inflammation, allergies.
